work.method: LCOE = (fixed charge rate × capital cost + fixed O&M) ÷ (capacity factor × 8.76 MWh per kW-year) + variable O&M + fuel cost, as NLR's Annual Technology Baseline defines it.
steps: Energy per kW of capacity: 25% × 8.76 MWh per kW-year = 2.19 MWh per kW-year.
Variable O&M $0.00/MWh and fuel $0.00/MWh are added as they are.
assumptions: The fixed charge rate carries the financing, taxes, and project life; it is entered, not computed.
Costs are in the same year's dollars; no default is offered, so every input is yours.
